observations.mechanism: Missing propagation of the request’s correlation ID (request context) across goroutine boundaries and outbound calls
observations.consequence: Logs cannot be correlated across components and blocked goroutine leaks remain invisible, reducing overall service observability and reliability

observations.mechanism: Network calls without a timeout keep workers blocked, and the unsynchronized early‑return leaves other goroutines waiting on unbuffered channels, both consuming the same worker pool
observations.consequence: The worker pool can be exhausted, causing the service to become unresponsive under load

observations.mechanism: Each iteration of the N+1 query builds a SQL statement by concatenating the user‑supplied warehouse parameter, so every per‑item query is an injection point
observations.consequence: An attacker can trigger many injection executions per request, dramatically increasing the potential data breach impact
